headline: European leaders debate legal seizure of frozen Russian central bank assets
summary: European policymakers are debating strategic and legal mechanisms to seize frozen Russian Central Bank assets to support Ukraine's economic reconstruction and defense requirements.
why: Approximately $300 billion in Russian foreign exchange reserves are immobilized in Western depositories, primarily within Euroclear in Belgium.

impacts.name: Ukraine
impacts.why: Potential asset confiscation would channel billions in sovereign reserves to Ukrainian reconstruction.
